run_training_experiment: run the lamb language model training experiment with cross-validation on a corpus file
run_crossvalidation_training: run cross-validation training on a corpus with multiple folds and rounds
run_tuner_training: run hyperparameter tuning training with an external tuner for the lamb language model
create_experiment_instance: create an Experiment instance with config, experiment directory, and optional tuner for training
read_corpus_file: read a word-based or character-based corpus file with specified encoding
